description: This Java class is a test utility that generates a SQL schema script based on JPA-annotated entities, using Hibernate for schema export. It is part of the test suite for the SalesManager project.

classes.name: ExportSchema
classes.description: A test class designed to generate a database schema script from entity classes, intended for setup and migration purposes.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates an SQL schema file (`schema.sql`) by exporting the database schema based on JPA entities, using Hibernate's SchemaExport.
